messages:
frank: Overlay ready for review — non-blocking modal with checklist + sample launcher. Figma: https://figma.redwood/overlay
elaine: We need low friction for demos. Can users skip?
frank: Yes. Primary: 'Try a sample project'  Secondary: 'Skip and explore'. Skipping pins a helper chip in the toolbar for 24h.
omar: Trap focus while modal open, Esc dismisses. Use focus-trap lib; lock body scroll.
lou: role=dialog, aria-modal=true, aria-labelledby + aria-describedby. Dismiss button should be first tab stop. Toast: aria-live=polite for sample success, assertive for dismiss.
maria: 'Skip and explore' may read as final in some locales. Suggest 'Maybe later' variant. Watch CTA length and line breaks.
frank: For demo: use 'Try a sample project' for en/us, fallback to 'Create workspace' for long locales.
omar: Respect prefers-reduced-motion; lazy-load images and fix card heights to avoid CLS.
lou: CTA contrast borderline at 12px — needs 4.5:1. Use 3px solid focus outline, not just shadow.
shirley: Legal requests 'trial tokens' instead of 'demo tokens'. Add data-onboard-v=overlay-v3 attribute for analytics.
ci-bot: preview (pr/902) created: https://preview.redwood/pr-902
frank: I'll run VoiceOver + NVDA on the preview. Please freeze copy by Tue EOD so we can ship the demo on Thu. Thanks! :rocket:
